mono.usage: OTPs, tracking IDs, timestamps, and capacity metrics

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Swiss Brutalist (Tactical Utility)
colors.strategy: Base is Bone White for light theme, Deep Obsidian for dark theme. Primary accent is Safety Orange for high-visibility actions (OTP, pickup, urgent alerts). Avoid 'SaaS Blue'.

admin_ops_dashboard.structure: F-pattern layout. Collapsible left sidebar for navigation. Top row for KPI summary cards, main content grid for charts (occupancy trend, deliveries by status) and tables.
admin_ops_dashboard.surface: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.

guard_dashboard.structure: Tablet/Mobile optimized view. High-visibility 'Log Arrival' primary CTA. Delivery room capacity meter prominent at top. Pending pickups queue below.
guard_dashboard.surface: High contrast data rows. Use 'Neo-Brutalist' borders (2px solid) or distinct background tints for urgent/perishable items.

learner_app.structure: Mobile-first view. Centered content max-w-md on desktop. Bottom navigation or top tabs (My Deliveries vs Register). Immersive status timeline.
learner_app.surface: Glassmorphism for sticky header and floating WhatsApp notifications. Large, rounded-2xl cards for OTP display.

components.cards: Cardless or 1px border flat cards. Avoid heavy box-shadows. Use rounded-2xl for Learner app, sharp (rounded-md) for Admin/Ops.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. High contrast hover states. Always explicitly set hover text color (e.g., hover:text-white).
components.timeline: Vertical step list with a continuous left border and bullet nodes. Active node glows with primary color.
components.whatsapp_feed: Floating side drawer or stack of styled Toasts (using Sonner). Mimic WhatsApp visually: pale green (#E7F6E7) for light mode / dark green (#005C4B) for dark mode speech bubbles, with timestamp and double checkmarks.
components.otp_display: Massive text size (text-5xl or text-6xl), JetBrains Mono font, tracking-[0.2em], centered in a high-contrast bounding box for easy scanning.
components.capacity_meter: Shadcn Progress component or simple half-donut Radial chart. Color shift (green -> yellow -> red) based on occupancy percentage.

motion.interactions: Hover states must have 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out'. Do NOT use 'transition-all' as it breaks transforms.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-up for list items (packages, logs).
motion.micro_animations: OTP reveal slide-down. Status change icons (like a delivery truck) should pulse on arrival.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure normal text is 4.5:1, large text 3:1. Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit').

guard_login_bg.description: Cardboard box on table. Use as a subtle background for Guard/Admin login.

learner_lifestyle.description: Students with mobile phones. Use for Learner login or empty state.

food_delivery_iconography.description: Food delivery bags. Use as a decorative element or thumbnail for 'Collect Immediately' food types.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle CSS noise background texture to the body for a tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) + 1px inner border for sticky nav and the WhatsApp drawer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.html or index.css.
Do NOT center align the .App container. Delete text-align: center from App.css.
Do NOT use native HTML <select>, <input type='date'>, or <dialog>. Use Shadcn Select, Calendar/DatePicker, and Dialog components.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications and heavily customize the toast component to look like WhatsApp chat bubbles for the learner notification feed.
Apply optical alignment over strict geometric alignment for buttons with icons (e.g., pr-4 pl-3).
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to everything (e.g., login-submit-button, tracking-timeline, otp-code).
For the delivery capacity meter, clearly display 'X / Y Slots Full' alongside the visual bar.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
